freeze: Independent additive scientific/ABI oracle, written before any digital/counter native implementation is authored or read. Literal words and asymmetric arguments are hand-declared; no product encoder/decoder, SDK, compiler, native call or runtime.

software_attempt_frontier_control.semantics: Each actual attempt owns one pre-FFI host start+interval frontier; early idle repeats frontier without SDK. Slow completion neither adds completion+interval nor triggers catchup bursts. No exact physical C-entry gap, fresh conversion, hardware sampling rate or RT guarantee.

clock_and_retention_contract.completion: Host monotonic sampled immediately after selected Read returns, before optional diagnostics/encoding/IPC. Preserve original clock for accepted data and exports. No device source_time.
clock_and_retention_contract.deadline: One original operation deadline and cutoff across setup/probes/read/publication. No native calls while early-idle; no Read in Finish; no retry/fallback/reconnect after terminal failure.
clock_and_retention_contract.diagnostics: Publish valid returned data/raw read status first. Deferred optional negative diagnostics precede other NI cleanup calls at Finish; diagnostic hang cannot erase received data or replace first code. Owned Stop/Clear only and cleanup uncertainty explicit.

legacy_preservation: All seven prior JSON byte hashes, all five C manual arrays (voltage, thermocouple, current, RTD, mixed eight-word), existing AI homogeneous/mixed rows and both timing modes remain unchanged.
qualification: Synthetic ABI/host lifecycle only. No physical NI USB/C-Series/chassis/OS/driver acceptance, routing/electrical/width readback beyond stated getter, simultaneity, missed-transition or real-time guarantee.
profile: one fresh owned counter INPUT per task; explicit on_demand only; edge-count U32 or frequency F64, never both in one task

public_boundary.channels: exactly ONE typed individual Device/ctrN object; no ranges/lists/MAX alias

critical_abi_distinction: Both selected counter array reads have seven slots and NO fillMode. Ex and scalar exports are different/unselected. Do not shift the output pointer by inserting DI/AI fill mode.

frequency_method_boundary: All four generic method codes/constructor slot values are explicit requests; no universal model acceptance, ignored-slot guarantee, local divisor scaling or coerced/read-back window is claimed. Low/two-counter/dynamic methods can reserve differing resources. Native rejection remains original; no fallback.

rules: Resolve only matching setter before CreateTask when terminal is supplied.
Exact requested physical bytes are the setter channel argument, matching constructor empty-virtual association; normalized queried actual name is independently checked.
Explicit null is rejected; omission does not call either getter/setter.
Native setter failure is terminal with owned cleanup, no retry/default or output route.
No getter buffer sizing-probe semantics are assumed.

identity_rules.actual_identity: normalized same device/ctrN as requested individual counter, no AI parser or automatic pin derivation
setup_faults: negative matching explicit terminal setter status

count_raw_extent_control.rule: A zero-valued received word is a valid sample when actual count1, including negative native status; distinct from actual0. Wrap-like decreases and repeated words remain exact snapshots, no unwrap/delta/reset/rollover inference. Synthetic sequence does not claim physical edge timing or hardware width.

frequency_raw_extent_control.rule: Preserve original F64 bits and finite numeric Hz without clipping/conversion. Nonfinite numeric key omitted; NaN payload and signed zero retained. Out-of-request-range synthetic words do not claim physical negative frequency or hardware behavior.

semantic_rules: No signed cast, accumulation, count difference, unwrap, inferred wrap count, local frequency or reset after decrease.
Hz numeric value comes only from driver-scaled F64, not host elapsed/count/divisor calculations.
Only exact one-counter task; no implicit multi-counter task support or shared AI/DI/CI task.
Input may configure/reserve hardware including paired counters/routes; no CO/write/output clock/export/reset/takeover and no passive-monitor promise.
